assumption_register.assumption: A positive nanosecond host interval converts to mach ticks with upward rounding and less than one tick of rounding excess.
assumption_register.basis: Retained Apple mach_time header and 125/3 native host ABI probe; u128 intermediate bounds.
assumption_register.dependent_result: Finite owner entry deadlines, independent of guest clocks.
assumption_register.stress_test: Integral/fractional timebases, one ns, u64 boundary, zero timebase and FOREVER exclusion.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: A positive interval truncates to zero, rounds down, overflows, or becomes u64::MAX.
assumption_register.status: confirmed for checked arithmetic and compiler-backed Mach ABI; SDK/hardware latency excluded

assumption_register.assumption: Successful finite SDK entry exposes the exit reason that the documented run-until operation returned. Physical already-expired/racing-deadline reason freshness is unknown.
assumption_register.basis: Retained Apple SDK hv_vcpu_run_until contract; no physical Intel host is available.
assumption_register.dependent_result: Real guest exits are dispatched before a later host deadline check.
assumption_register.stress_test: Prepared exits, internal exit storms, already-expired policy and IO/debug/fail-entry at expiry in the SDK model.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: A stale reason is dispatched twice, or real IO/debug/fail-entry is discarded only because time elapsed.
assumption_register.status: retained; complete SDK models pass, physical already-expired/racing SDK return freshness remains unknown

assumption_register.assumption: The qualified SDK timer ownership is limited to pin-control bit6; hidden SDK deadlines are reset by the documented FOREVER entry. Physical post-return control behavior is unknown.
assumption_register.basis: Retained SDK uses VMX preemption timer for finite deadlines; current context policy forbids dynamic pin controls.
assumption_register.dependent_result: Host timer state stays outside guest checkpoint bytes and finite/unbounded transitions do not retain an expired deadline.
assumption_register.stress_test: Model timer-bit mutation, unexpected policy changes, partial setters, raw capture/restore and finite/FOREVER/finite calls; count pin-field writes during restore independently of modeled SDK masking
assumption_register.falsification_probe: Capture publishes an SDK timer bit/deadline, or unbounded entry inherits finite expiration. A restore writes fixed pin controls, even if a masking SDK fixture happens to preserve the timer bit.
assumption_register.status: revised after observed extra pin write; corrected complete debug/no-debug SDK models pass; physical SDK timer ownership remains unknown

assumption_register.assumption: Interrupted delivery is admitted only with a supported reinjection contract; otherwise bounded entry fails closed before re-entry. Physical SDK reinjection behavior is unknown.
assumption_register.basis: Current run loop has no general IDT-vectoring reinjection handler; read-only vectoring fields are not checkpoint candidates.
assumption_register.dependent_result: A host scheduling yield does not silently lose or duplicate an interrupted guest event.
assumption_register.stress_test: Valid vectoring information/error code, an occupied entry event, timer expiry and fail-entry flag priority.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: The CPU resumes after unsupported interrupted delivery, silently claims successful general reinjection, or turns an entry failure into a host yield. The model's retained entry-valid bit alone cannot prove preservation of an interrupted hardware event.
assumption_register.status: retained; unsupported vectoring fails closed in complete models; general and physical reinjection remain unimplemented/unqualified

bounded_scope.finding: Physical Intel SDK deadline expiry, timer visibility and guest execution are unavailable on this M4 host.
General IDT-vectoring event reinjection remains unimplemented; unexpected valid vectoring fails closed and fences later entry.
KVM/native Arm bounded host scheduling, complete backend startup/IRQ/clocks and deterministic concurrent replay remain separate requirements.
The 10 ms interval bounds the SDK entry deadline, with conversion rounding under one Mach tick; SDK granularity and host/owner/bookkeeping latency are outside that bound.

SDK_model_limits.entry_event_slot: This component's SDK model retains VM-entry event valid across normal modeled exits. Intel SDM Vol.3C29.2 clears valid on normal VM exit;28.8 preserves it on failed entry. The retained-slot assertion is model storage evidence, not architectural event-delivery evidence. A corrected model and explicit normal/failed-entry regression are prepared in the separate interrupt-window group; no backend valid-bit clear is required.

resolved_by.scope: Current fixture now clears event-valid on normal exits and preserves it for failed entry; original scheduling evidence remains historical model-storage evidence.
